sources.source_processing: Take every row from main CEA table index4; sort dates ascending and strip numeric thousands separators only. No row deletion, no deduplication, no date fill, no price recomputation, no splice.

volume.missing: 0 surprise plus 0 valid mask; genuine observed zero volume is valid
